headline: Everyday selling, made simple
description: Find products by name or barcode, browse familiar categories, and start a sale from one clear checkout screen.

headline: See every item. Know every total.
description: Review quantities, prices, and the running total in a clear cart before taking payment.

headline: Give customers a choice
description: Choose Cash or GCash from a straightforward payment screen that keeps the sale total in view.

headline: Clear totals. Confident change.
description: Enter the amount received and see the change immediately, with a large keypad and Filipino helper labels.

headline: Your products, organized
description: Review product prices and stock levels, edit product details, and adjust inventory from one practical workspace.

headline: Know what needs restocking
description: Bring low-stock and out-of-stock products into focus so your next replenishment starts with a clear list.

headline: Keep stock changes in view
description: Review a permanent movement history with product, employee, date, and movement-type filters.

headline: Understand the day’s sales
description: Review completed sales, payment totals, voids, and stock indicators with date and employee filters.

headline: Manage your store team
description: Keep employee access organized with manager and cashier roles and employee PIN controls.

headline: Finish the shift with clarity
description: Confirm shift closure with clear reminders about signing out and keeping audit records saved.
